content: Your mission to "100% codingame" is very impressive, however I don't think creating easy leetcode problems en mass as community problems is very helpful. These basic tasks are almost certainly duplicates, in the case of this specific problem "https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/1228d62225c1f6ea86732eb4defb637c49" seems like one. I'd encourage you to check out codingame.tools for searching past problems. I don't have much right to criticise, I'm sure you are a better coder than me by many orders of magnitude, these are just my thoughts.
